title: PatchPad Editor - Model Run QC
subtitle: Analysis of job-675826d6.zip run artifact.
note: This artifact is a model trial for openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-sol, not an Oracle/golden run. It used the older 32-criterion rubric, so it should be treated as stale model-run evidence after the rubric compression.

tasks.name: PatchPad Editor - job-675826d6
tasks.headline: The model scored too high on the old rubric, but the failed checks align with the newly upweighted hard criteria.

findings.what: The run scored 0.8736 with 28/32 browser criteria passing.
findings.why: The current task now has 20 criteria and different weights, so this result does not validate the latest task package.
findings.impact: Do not use this run as final Oracle or final model-spread evidence for the current PatchPad version.
findings.fix: Run the current patchpad-editor.zip again after rubric compression and golden undo fixes.

findings.what: The model score is above the desired below-0.7 target on the old rubric.
findings.why: The old rubric had many separate easy checks, so passing broad editor basics outweighed the hard undo and multi-caret failures.
findings.impact: The old scoring shape was too forgiving for a model-breaking target.
findings.fix: Keep the compressed 20-criterion rubric where simple related checks are merged and hard failures carry 2.0 weight.
findings.evidence: Old run failed 4 criteria: undo_contiguous_typing_group, undo_paste_cut_replace_atomic, revision_history_records_versions, and multi_caret_alt_click. With the current 20-criterion weights, those same four failures would roughly score 8.0/15.5 = 0.516 if all other current checks passed.

findings.what: The run exposed genuine undo grouping and revision restore edge cases in an earlier solution state.
findings.why: Typing was recorded per keystroke, selection replacement typing was not atomic, multi-caret word insertion required multiple undos, and restoring a revision saved immediately instead of becoming an undoable dirty draft.
findings.impact: Those defects would make Oracle fail if present in the reference solution.
findings.fix: These were addressed in the current golden solution before this run-QC pass: grouped contiguous typing, grouped selection replacement, grouped multi-caret typed insertion, and restore-as-dirty-draft with one-step undo.
findings.evidence: Verifier report failed the four criteria with detailed judge reasoning matching these defects.

blocks.title: Run Artifact Summary
items: Structural anomalies: none reported by run_inventory.py.

blocks.title: Failed Criteria In The Run
items: undo_contiguous_typing_group: one Undo removed only the last typed character instead of the whole contiguous typed word.
undo_paste_cut_replace_atomic: paste and cut were atomic, but replacing a selected word by typing was undone one character at a time.
revision_history_records_versions: restore immediately created a saved revision and disabled Undo instead of leaving an undoable dirty draft.
multi_caret_alt_click: multi-caret creation, typing, Backspace, and Delete mostly worked, but Undo removed only one typed character per caret instead of the whole typed word.

blocks.title: Interpretation
items: This is useful model-run evidence showing the task can catch real implementation misses.
It is not final evidence because it predates the 20-verifier compressed rubric and the current golden fixes.
The latest package still needs a fresh Oracle run for score 1.0 and fresh model runs for the below-0.7 target.
